title: Onboarding
summary: Teaches a codebase or workflow to someone new — concepts in order, a guided tour, and a toy walkthrough.

page_types.purpose: Give a reader (live or async) a one-screen kickoff: what this artifact is, who should read which page, and how to ask questions.
Introduce every concept a newcomer needs, each defined before it's relied on.
Walk the real codebase in a sensible order, pointing out what matters and what to skip.
Illustrate the hardest concept with small, concrete toy code (at most 50 lines per file).
Give the newcomer something to try, plus where to look when they get stuck.

default_sources.describe: The repo's grounding wiki, when one exists — commit-pinned notes already verified against the code
default_sources.hint: docs/wiki/INDEX.md first, then the notes it points to; skip when absent
